description: Meet the RipTide, a compact folding electric bike built for easy everyday rides, beach trips, campus cruising, RV travel, and quick city commutes. With a lightweight magnesium alloy frame, 16-inch pneumatic tires, and a space-saving folding design, RipTide is easy to ride, easy to store, and easy to bring along wherever the day takes you. Powered by a 350W brushless motor with 525W peak output, RipTide delivers smooth, quiet acceleration and a comfortable top speed of up to 20 mph. The 36V 7.8Ah battery offers 30+ miles of riding range, giving you plenty of power for errands, neighborhood rides, or weekend adventures. RipTide is designed with practical features that make every ride more convenient, including front and rear disc brakes, LED headlight and taillight, rear rack, digital display, and a sturdy 265 lb max load capacity. When the ride is over, simply fold it down and load it into your car, closet, garage, or RV with ease. Key Features 350W brushless motor with 525W peak power Up to 20 mph max speed 36V 7.8Ah high-capacity battery 30+ miles of range 16-inch pneumatic tires Front and rear disc brakes Lightweight magnesium alloy frame Folding design for easy storage and transport LED headlight and taillight Rear rack included 265 lb max load capacity UL 2849 certified Compact, capable, and ready for fun — RipTide makes electric riding simple.

components.description: Carry cargo on the integrated rear rack and stay clean with included fenders. Ready for commuting, errands, or weekend adventures.
